svg.title: Keyring threat model
svg.desc: Three zones: people and attackers on the internet, Keyring in your Azure subscription, and the Microsoft cloud. Two trust boundaries separate them. Every call that reads or changes a vault carries the signed-in person's on-behalf-of token; Keyring's managed identity only writes audit rows and sends email. Red T-numbers mark where each threat in the STRIDE table is stopped.
svg.text: Trust boundaries, data flows and where each threat is stopped. Red T-numbers match the STRIDE table in docs/threat-model.md.
